title: Portfolio hero gallery, logo-only product covers, and capability icon correction
locator: cd jossue-portfolio && npm run validate; Playwright screenshots test-results/mobile-hero-gallery-final-1.png, test-results/mobile-capability-icons-final.png, test-results/mobile-brand-covers-final.png, test-results/desktop-hero-gallery-final.png, test-results/desktop-brand-covers-final.png; npx astro dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4321 --background; curl -I http://192.168.100.110:4321/es/
result: PASS: updated home hero to a real lateral gallery with horizontal overflow, scroll-snap, controls, circular prev/next navigation, and text/CTAs over the generated CSS/SVG illustration layer. Verified mobile hero track metrics were clientWidth 521 and scrollWidth 1562. Product/project covers now remove product screenshots from the card cover composition and keep category plus centered brand mark/wordmark with the existing brand-cover design. Capability card icons were resized and aligned as visible top-right block marks. npm run validate passed: Astro check 0 diagnostics, ESLint passed, build generated 29 pages, route test passed for 29 routes plus robots/sitemap, link test passed for 495 local links, Playwright passed 168/168. limitations: PUBLIC_SITE_URL was unset, so Astro used portfolio.invalid fallback in validation. Mobile touch validation still requires phone and Mac on the same LAN.
